answer_prose: Across 16 eligible editions at 15–19.9°C, the average edition-median finish was 2.5% slower than the earlier benchmark; across 69 editions below 10°C, it was 0.7% faster. The course and field mix differs, so this is not a measured temperature penalty.
detail_prose: Each race edition receives equal weight. Temperature bands still contain different courses and fields, so these differences are not a temperature penalty.
